scenarios.task: Replace corroded exterior lighting circuits on the Massabielle Grotto rock face walkway while pilgrims route is cordoned off
hazards: wet rock surfaces near Gave de Pau
steps: Obtain permit and confirm circuit lockout at panel
Test absence of voltage at fixture junction boxes
Pull new THWN conductors through existing conduit
Seal junction boxes to IP65 against river damp
Verify grounding continuity and restore power
Remove lockout and inspect under load

rubric.pass_if: Applies and removes lockout in correct sequence with verified zero-energy state
All devices rated and sealed for wet locations
Barricade separates work zone from pilgrim walkway before work begins
Ground-fault and continuity tests pass before re-energizing

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and conducts visual inspection of overhead conduit runs on uneven grotto terrain before the apprentice works.

scenarios.task: Set poles and hang feeders for temporary lighting towers along the torchlight procession route
steps: Survey pole locations and verify clearances to crowd route
Rig pole to digger derrick and set in augered hole
Backfill, tamp, and plumb pole
Hang neutral and phase conductors with hot-line tools
Energize from isolated generator and verify tower circuits
Night-check glare control toward procession path

rubric.pass_if: Minimum approach distances maintained from any energized conductor
Uses standard line-person signals for every lift and set
No conductor or tool passes over uncontrolled public area
Temporary system grounded per spec before energization

scenarios.task: Grade and stabilize a washed-out section of the Gave de Pau riverbank below the sanctuary embankment
steps: Walk the bank and mark underground utilities
Install silt fence along waterline before grading
Set excavator on firm ground mats above the washout
Load and place riprap keyed into the bank toe
Compact backfill in lifts and restore drainage swale
Remove controls and inspect water for turbidity

rubric.pass_if: Excavator never tracks within rollover-risk zone of saturated edge
Silt barrier installed before earthwork and intact after
All marked utilities avoided and unstruck
Bank restored to grade with riprap keyed below scour line

scenarios.robot_role: Tows ground-penetrating radar sled along the bank to map soft soils and buried utilities before excavation.

scenarios.task: Erect a tube-and-clamp scaffold over the basilica crypt stair landing for masonry repointing access
steps: Verify base plates on sole boards and level the stair landing
Build frames with coupling pins and cross braces each lift
Toe-board, guardrail, and net each working platform
Tag scaffold complete with load rating
Inspect daily and before each shift change
Dismantle top-down with tool lanyards in use

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off above 6 feet and guardrails complete on all open sides
Toe boards, nets, and tool lanyards deployed over occupied areas
Green tag signed by competent person before use
No base plate or clamp marring stonework; padding used

scenarios.task: Retrofit hydronic heating loops in the sanctuary hospitality block serving bathers after thermal immersion
steps: Isolate, drain, and lock out heating loops
Cut out corroded fittings and capture water for disposal
Pressure-test new copper with nitrogen before brazing
Brazed joints cooled, flushed, and sampled per water plan
Reinsulate lines and restore circulation
Log valve lineup and temperatures for commissioning

rubric.pass_if: All energy sources locked out with drain verified open
Hot-work permit, fire watch, and nitrogen purge during brazing
Flush and sampling protocol completed before return to service
Test held at 1.5x working pressure with zero decay

scenarios.task: Fabricate and install a heat-and-smoke relief duct above the votive candle racks at the grotto esplanade
hazards: hot work near wax and textiles
steps: Template the stone arch opening without drilling heritage rock
Fabricate galvanized duct breaks in shop with lock seams
Hot-work permit and fire watch at candle racks before tacking
Hang duct from freestanding frame, not masonry anchors
Balance louvers for natural convection draw
Verify airflow clears smoke at candle-line height

rubric.pass_if: No drilling or anchoring into grotto stone; freestanding support used
Permit, wax clearance, and fire watch present for every tack
Edges deburred and gloves used; no lacerations
Smoke test shows clearance at rack level

scenarios.robot_role: Handles repetitive duct-seam folding and deburr in the shop, keeping the apprentice off the brake press.

scenarios.task: Clear silted drain vault behind the grotto that carries bath-house runoff to the river system
hazards: cave-in of soft bank soil at entry
steps: Secure entry permit and post attendant at vault mouth
Test atmosphere at three depths pre-entry
Ventilate vault with forced air and retest
Enter with retrieval tripod and lifeline attached
Muck out to grade and seal with clean gravel filter
Decontaminate gear and close permit
ppe: supplied-air or SCBA as readings require

rubric.pass_if: Permit completed and attendant posted before entry
Continuous monitoring with forced ventilation before and during entry
Tripod rigged and attendant can extract entrant non-entry
All gear deconned before leaving site; runoff contained

scenarios.robot_role: Enters the vault first with gas sensors and camera, mapping atmosphere and silt depth so humans enter only if safe.

scenarios.task: Reset heaved concrete pavers on the procession esplanade where crowd loads and frost have broken the bed
steps: Cordon work cell and sign a crowd detour
Lift slabs with vacuum handler, never by hand alone
Recut edges wet only with dust extraction
Regrade sand bed and reset to datum with stringline
Vibrate-set, sand-joint, and sweep finish
Check trip-hazard tolerance under 6 mm before reopening

rubric.pass_if: Mechanical lifting used for all slabs over 25 kg
Wet cutting or extraction used; dry cutting prohibited
Detour signed and no reopen until passable
Joints flush within 6 mm; no trip edges remain

scenarios.robot_role: Shuttles joint sand and small tools across the cordoned plaza so the apprentice stays off trip edges.

credential.name: Sanctuaries Site Readiness Card (Lourdes Curable Cell)
